audit.whatIsWrong: The entire page is built around an ability that does not exist: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. It appears in winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and four report entries. Hwei's CC palette is Subject: Torment (E), which unlocks Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. Two further fabrications: Spiraling Despair was called 'R displacement' twice — it slows, damages and explodes, it does not displace — and spikes[2] referred to 'his passive shield stacks', when Signature of the Visionary is a damage detonation, not a shield. The shield comes from Subject: Serenity (W).
audit.why: Riot's texts name all four palettes and their sub-spells directly. The packet defect for this matchup says outright that the page 'never names any of Hwei's abilities'.
audit.corrected: Every 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' replaced with Subject: Torment; the R described as an expanding slow-and-explode painting rather than a displacement; the passive described as the two-spell signature detonation it is.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike claimed Akali bursts 'through his passive shield stacks'. There are no passive shield stacks.
audit.why: Signature of the Visionary primes an enemy on the first damaging spell and detonates when a SECOND lands. That is Hwei's real burst spike, and it is the thing to play around: never take two spells in a row.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text rewritten around Subject: Serenity's shield and the passive's true function; the two-spell rule added to breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.feeding.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and sequencingCues is 0. Not one number appeared on the page.
audit.why: Subject: Torment is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 — that is the wait-for-X window the whole matchup turns on. Subject: Disaster is 10 down to 6, Subject: Serenity 18 down to 16, Spiraling Despair 120/100/80 at 1300 range against Akali's 675.
audit.corrected: The 12-second Torment window written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, loading, winCon, report[5].t and report[9].t.

audit.why: Favoured 4/10 against a 52.22% win rate over 2568 games is a touch generous, and a 7-of-7 Akali chart is generous too — but both layers agree on every row and nothing in either kit gives me a grounded reason to hand Hwei a stage. Hwei has no dash, no blink and no self-peel beyond Subject: Serenity's speed and shield, so Akali does own every stage in kind.

edits.before: Level 6 turns the lane into a stomp: your R closes his range advantage in an instant, and since he has no escape besides a knockback/displacement on long cooldown, a well-timed all-in from stealth usually ends the fight before he can react. A well-timed all-in from stealth ends the fight before he can react. Keep abusing brush and fog, since his poke requires him to see and aim at you first.

notes: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' is a fabricated ability name and it was the load-bearing term across twelve fields on this page, including focus.text and loading — the two the player reads on the loading screen. Hwei's CC palette is Subject: Torment (E). Also removed two other inventions: Spiraling Despair described as a displacement (it is an expanding slow that explodes) and 'passive shield stacks' (Signature of the Visionary is a two-spell damage detonation; the shield is Subject: Serenity). The focus.text edit shortens 30 chars to 25 and may fall outside the length band — if the applier rejects it, that field keeps the fabricated name and should be fixed by hand. Chart deliberately untouched: both layers already agree on all seven rows. Left breakdown.wave, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, tradeGood, tradeBad and ahead templated.
